storyName: Two Ends of a Dead Knot
storyInfo: Crownslayer builds a network with the workers of Grypherburg by supplying the energy in shortage. As she seeks a new comms device to keep in contact with her supplier, she runs into Gummy who happens to have some clues.

attributes.content: <p=1>Rhodes Island Provisional Office, Deity Grypherburg</><p=2>One week before the Winter Ball</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Dur-nar, I brought my report—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: ...Dur-nar?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: There is no sign of any person, only a scene of utter chaos. Crownslayer forces her way through the multitude of cardboard boxes.
What a mess... I can hardly see the floor.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Dur-nar—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Is there somebody there?
Instructor Dur-nar's not here. You can give the report to me.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Oh, it's you.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Where's Dur-nar?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Not sure. I just got back a few days ago. Lada—I mean, Gummy and I are the only ones here.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: We only just got approval to set up the new office, so the others are probably busy with red-tape and whatever. I'm heading out, too, in a bit; there's a Student Assembly letter that I need to send—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Here's my report. Please give it to her.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Okay.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Just a sec.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: What is it?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Uh...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You're always on your own. I guess you're not really into talking to us, but we're all from Ursus, and now we're all Rhodes Island operators.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Everything's starting from scratch with this new office. I was thinking maybe we could get more done by helping each other out.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: ...What do you want?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: That's not what I mean! What I'm trying to say is, if you need something, feel free to ask for help from the office, from any of us. You don't have to do everything yourself.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Of course, we'll ask if we need your help.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Instructor Dur-nar says the only contact you get with anybody is submitting your reports. Not that there's anything wrong with doing your own thing, but I thought I might check in with you, since you're here.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You wouldn't want me to show up here more.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Don't try to decide what I think. I know you had something to do with Chernobog and Reunion, but I don't know what you did, and I'm not about to find out.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: It's a wound that keeps getting reopened, but trying to avoid it won't help it heal either.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The important thing is that you're on our side, and we can use as many people on our side as we can get.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: So, yeah, if you ever find yourself in need of help, just give us a call.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Hey!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Thank you.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I will, if I need it.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: <p=1>Academy Riverside Police Station, Deity Grypherburg</><p=2>Dec 24, 7:45 A.M.</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Lyudmila!
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: ...I was just going to put in your bail.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Well, you can thank that kind soul for saving us the bail money!
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: How did you get out? And what was that explosion just now...?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: —Run—
attributes.name: Distant Voice

attributes.content: After them—!
attributes.name: Distant Voice

attributes.content: Nothing to see here, just another ordinary afternoon in Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: Never mind that for now, I better get out of here in case the cops show up, or I'll be back in that hole.
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: Don't go back yet. Come with me. I have questions.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: How did you know the cops got me? I thought I was gonna rot in there for sure.
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: Someone saw the cops questioning you. You remember the kid who lives across the street?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Kid? The redhead? I remember I didn't like that brooding look of his—
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: Don't judge people by appearances. Have you sold all your goods?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: There was one who didn't meet with me. I was waiting for him when I got arrested. Bloke from Odoyev... what's his name again?
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: Rus, occupation: barber. Lives on Fifth Avenue. Two infants at home, wife died of flu complications.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Yes... that's the one. I got everyone else.
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: How did they pay for the energy converters?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Huh? I thought they didn't have to pay? They get the energy converters for free as long as they keep buying the goods from us.
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: Correct.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You were testing me! You trust me that little?
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: People who are trustworthy don't usually end up in jail.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Come on, let's not talk about that!
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: Were you concerned that me or someone else might be selling the energy converters behind your back?
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: Not gonna happen. Everyone's in your debt. We'd all be frozen solid without you. We have nothing but gratitude towards you—
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: No, I understand some of you would like to make more money, but you should not do it by exploiting people who are in even more need than you are. That's not what I wanted to see when I chose to sell through you guys.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I have other channels, but I chose to work with you instead of working on my own. You should understand that all it does is add extra risk.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Honestly, I don't understand why you're doing this... you're just doing good by people with nothing in it for you.
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: I've dealt with Rus's case, but we need to put the recruitment of new clients on hold for now. I'll let you know when there are any updates.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Oh? Will our supplies be cut?
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: Our reserves can meet the needs of existing users for about two weeks. I'll try to get supply restored during this time.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: If any new clients show up, use discretion and due diligence, and help out where you can with the money that I gave you, but don't tell them about the supply chain issues. We don't want to cause panic.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Of course, I trust you... anything I can help with?
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: No, this is my responsibility. I might be away for a few days. Find some excuse if anyone asks.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Thank you.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Sure, but how do I reach you if something happens?
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: Come here and leave a note, just like I taught you.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Lyudmila! Haven't seen you down here for a while. Are you going outside the city?
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Worker

attributes.content: Yes, I have something to do. Is there an unguarded exit ahead?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: No, but they won't give you any trouble if they see you.
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Worker

attributes.content: Any suspicious intruders from the mobility layer recently?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: No. Police patrols have dropped too. If you're asking which exit has no cops watching, it's the same answer as usual. They only come at fixed hours; we keep a watch the rest of the time.
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Worker

attributes.content: Good, thank you.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Come back soon!
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Worker

attributes.content: I think this is the place...
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Crownslayer kneels and wipes away the dust, revealing an etched mark on the floor.
She looks up and sees identical emergency ladders neatly installed between the layers. She climbs one of them and goes deeper into the mobility layer.
Can you hear me?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Hello?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Is it safe on your side?
This is a new safehouse. It's been checked for mics and cameras.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Good. I don't have much time...
...Are you alright?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Not great, but that's not important. They may have found out about us transferring energy to Grypherburg. I haven't faced any consequences yet...
They've updated their base stations. It's likely that they'll be building new energy pipelines next, then abandon the old one. We need to make a couple of preparations before that.
You planning to tap the new pipeline?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: We must.
The original pipeline was already basically a dedicated Tsarevgrad one. Now they're probably going to pave it straight to the palace. They don't even care about the other nobles anymore.
They say it's to 'conserve resources', but how is it not a waste to keep building pipelines that could be destroyed by Catastrophe any moment?
I heard workers are already being reassigned over here. Anything of the sort from Grypherburg?
No... Grypherburg is dealing with its own problems.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You mean the students—
Although news about the ore exhaustion got out, what you're researching has bought the council time. The Fourth Army also had to dealt with internal unrest of its own...
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Nobles, soldiers, workers, no one is making any rash moves right now, except for these students who are completely ignorant of the currents under the surface.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Oh, I'm not accusing you. But if you could tell me more about what you're researching—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Let's talk about the topic at hand first. The old pipeline should remain in service until the new one is complete, but we'll need to find a different way to communicate.
If I recall correctly, your comms are using a foreign company's independent network?
Yes, a rental base station operated by a foreign-owned company in Ursus.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: That's the problem. Even foreign-owned companies are potentially subject to intense surveillance, especially after the Far North Broadcast.
Not even if we use a new anonymous channel each time?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: The base stations on my end have been updated. Hard to tell if someone might have added new 'features'. Can you find radio equipment with an independent network, one that doesn't use a commercial base station?
You're talking about high-level military equipment? That might take some time.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Try. If you succeed, you can continue to reach me on this channel.
If you don't... you may have to wait for me to find an opportunity to contact you from my end. If you don't hear from me in two weeks, destroy all evidence of ever having communicated with me.
...We'll all do our best.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Take care.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You too.
<p=1>Rhodes Island Provisional Office, Deity Grypherburg</><p=2>Days after the Winter Ball</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: I really can't go out to help?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Leto just went out after leaving a letter. Istina and the others don't come back to the office much either. Don't they need my help?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Zima was taken away because she tried to help me, but I couldn't do anything—
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I know you're worried, Gummy, but someone needs to stay here to deal with the office's work until the next group of operators arrive in Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Building a new Oripathy treatment center, assisting the government with the registration and monitoring of Oripathy patients... there's a lot to do.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Besides, we're making sure that they can focus on whatever it is they have to do.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: I know it's important, but I'm the only one who's not helping rescue Zima...
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I don't want to be like that. They wouldn't have gotten Zima if I wasn't being dumb that night!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I know how you feel, Little Cub, but I promised Istina to protect—
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Is Zima in?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Huh?
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: The cops took Zima—oh, Crownslayer!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: ...You can call me Lyudmila. What do you mean, the cops took Zima?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Govno, I should have come sooner. Do you know where she is? How can I help?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Zima is in the quarantine zone. We're making plans to rescue her.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: The quarantine zone? Katorga Raion? That's basically Pavlovich's own little fiefdom. What can you—what can Rhodes do?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: The Ursus Student Self-Government Group... the children are trying to rescue their own.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: But I'm not helping! Zima's in there because of me, and there's nothing I can do...
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: You're sure Zima's being held in the quarantine zone?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Rosa has confirmed it through multiple sources, and she's apparently seen Pavlovich herself.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: But she couldn't get Zima out... or rather, Zima doesn't want to leave.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Zima doesn't want to leave?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Why do you say that—
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: A hunch.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Do you have any advanced communicators here that run on their own network without using a commercial base station? I've asked all my contacts, but there's no one selling this stuff, even on the black market.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Sounds like something that only the military will have, or folks like Closure who like to fiddle with things on their own.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Most branch offices will not have something of that grade without making a special application. Why do you need it?
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Saving lives.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Rosa said there's a radio blackout on the quarantine zone. Even those communicators won't work.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: (Lowers voice) No, I need to contact the one who's helping me steal electricity.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: My communications there may be compromised. I need a more secure method.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Steal—
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: Steal electricity?!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Not so loud.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: So you're the one behind the cheap energy in the city these days.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: I had a lot of help.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Well, I guess I shouldn't be so surprised. You came to Ursus before us, and you were the one who built our intelligence network in the Central Governorate.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: I'll be going if there's no such communicator at the office. Take care of yourselves. I'll see what I can do about Zima.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You take care too. Stay hidden.
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: (Mutters) Communicator... communicator?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I remember now!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: The listening device that we used on the day of the ball was a student's handiwork. Zima said she built her very own set of radio equipment—
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Where is this student now?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: ...I don't know. Zima got the stuff, I guess she's the only one who knows them.
attributes.name: Gummy
